narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think adding always makes the floor higher, so minus presses must still go up.
<bookmark mark='down'/>Watch the lift. Start on plus four and press minus three, and the lift moves down.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A minus press takes the lift below its starting floor, never above it.
